programme.title: Motown Bride
programme.desc: Bride Sashani dreamed of being a pop star. Now she wants a Motown wedding. But her bridesmaids' dresses make the bridesmaids' look like Santa's helpers, and her design is a disaster! David Tutera creates a triple platinum event, featuring over-the-top sequined gowns, wall-to-wall music, and a Grammy-award- winning star!

programme.title: Control Bride
programme.desc: Bride Leigh-Ann's future mother-in-law planned her wedding. Now David Tutera is giving his bride total control of her big day. She'll have to choose everything herself - from bridal gowns to tablecloths and flowers. But Leigh-Ann just moved to Los Angeles from Canada, and the wedding is only three weeks away! Is David’s shy bride ready to face the big decisions?

programme.title: Mad Men Bride
programme.desc: Bride Taylor and her fiancé Jason love the TV show "Mad Men." But they have no idea how to give their wedding that classic sixties swing. Taylor's bridal gown is totally modern and their décor is a mish-mash. David Tutera goes straight to the source for inspiration - including a very special surprise at the "Mad Men" studios! It's a fabulous wedding for a bride who wants to feel like she's stepped back in time.

programme.title: Masquerade Bride
programme.desc: Bride Berda is getting married on Halloween. And sure enough, her wedding details include orange plastic pumpkins, spider webs, and skulls. So far she has no venue, and only photographs of her bridesmaid's dresses. David Tutera wants this beautiful bride to be bold. So he transforms her ticky-tacky theme into an elegant masquerade ball, complete with a Venetian gondolier and truly amazing decor!

programme.title: Under the Sea Bride
programme.desc: Bride Diamond wants to feel like she’s under the sea at her wedding, even if that means wearing a scuba suit with a veil! This over-the-top bride has twelve bridesmaids she wants to dance the wobble, and centerpieces filled with live goldfish. David Tutera takes Diamond's outlandish ideas and creates an amazing fantasy wedding, fit for a mermaid princess.

programme.desc: This NFL linebacker, his bride, and their wedding party of 23 will enjoy a tropical fantasy theme complete with cabanas, a mojito bar, and palm trees. Famed cake maker Sylvia Weinstock will be on hand to present her 5-foot tall cake to the happy couple.

programme.title: Hearts Bride
programme.desc: When David Tutera meets Heather Homan and Josh Tomes of Ontario, California, he finds a couple with a terrific theme for their wedding, but horrible execution. They want their wedding to be a celebration of love: hearts and the color pink everywhere but have wound up with a tacky disaster. From the zebra ties to the pink centerpieces to the glow sticks they plan to give to their guests; this couple really needs David’s expertise! Just when David thought it couldn’t get any worse, the couple tells him that, with only three weeks before the wedding, they don’t even have a venue yet! David uses the next three weeks sprucing up Heather’s bland bridesmaid dresses, putting her into a fantastic party dress, and most importantly, finding the couple the right venue. The surprises don’t stop there, as David takes the entire bridal party on a hair-raising day of fun!

programme.title: Monopoly Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera faces one of the toughest challenges of his career when he meets Tasha and Evan of Los Angeles, California and finds out their theme: the board game “Monopoly”! With menus and centerpieces designed to resemble game cards, and a plan to have their guests pay for their food with fake money, David wonders if they’ve been planning a wedding or a child’s birthday party! Things get worse when David finds out that neither Tasha nor her brides like their dresses, which are far too revealing, and to top it off, they’re planning on having the ceremony and reception in a friend’s back yard! David had just three weeks to keep this couple’s dreams from going directly to jail!

programme.title: Belly Dancing Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera’s weddings work best when his couples incorporate something from their own life into their wedding as their theme, but when he meets Shirley and Andy from Los Angeles, California, he finds a theme that poses a huge challenge: belly dancing. Shirley absolutely loves her hobby but may have gone a little overboard in her planning: she plans to put herself and her brides in noisy shimmy belts, has peacock feather centerpieces, and to top it all off, she’s had a fake foam cake made to save money! Shirley’s bridesmaid dresses are a mismatched mess that don’t fit their body types, and when David sees Shirley’s dress, he’s floored by how big and dramatic it is, not at all matching Shirley’s personality or her theme. David’s biggest challenge might be yet to come, however, because Shirley’s venue for the wedding is a small Indian restaurant! In three weeks, David has to take this mismatched mess of a wedding and turn it into the ultimate sexy, exotic celebration of the art of belly dancing.

programme.title: Royal Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera is used to his brides wanting to feel like royalty on their wedding day, but when he meets Tracey from Sherman Oaks, California, he finds a bride who’s take that idea even further! Tracey wants the have the ultimate royal wedding, complete with crowns and miniature castles, but when she shows David some of her wedding materials, he sees the making of a royal disaster. The items Tracey has put together are mismatched, and don’t speak to the regal, opulent feel that Tracey’s is looking for, and neither her gown nor her bridesmaids dresses are appropriate for a royal wedding. David has only three weeks to change every aspect of Tracey’s wedding to give her the royal wedding she’s always wanted.

programme.title: Goth Bride
programme.desc: They say anything goes in Hollywood, but wedding planner David Tutera is shocked to find out that bride Christina wants a wedding based on black. And she means it – Christina shows David a black bridal gown, black bridesmaids’ dresses and finally a tiny black flower girl dress for her darling seven-year old daughter! Even her fiancé Eric tells David the wedding should be black, dark and creepy to fit their all-goth fashion style! David finds himself surrounded by enough skeletons, skulls and spiders to decorate a Halloween party, but nothing in wedding white. And when he takes Christina to a bridal shop filled with white dresses, she nearly has an anxiety attack! David has to find out just what makes this adorable goth bride tick, and when he does, he delivers a high-fashion, romantic wedding that’s perfect for Christina.

programme.desc: Wedding planner David Tutera meets a bride whose passion for fashion is so extreme, that she spent most of her budget on a designer dress and shoes, leaving the rest of her wedding behind. This shopaholic bride is even confused about her theme - she wants a frivolous, flouncy Marie-Antoinette look with some rustic birch logs and confetti thrown in for good measure! David comes to the rescue of this good-hearted fashionista and turns her wedding into a runway success.

programme.title: Tuscany Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera loves Tuscany, Italy, and so does his latest bride Jane. She wants a romantic outdoor wedding, but her vision of what Tuscany looks like is more than a little skewed, and her bright orange bridesmaid's dresses are only adding to the disaster. Worst of all, the bride, the groom, and the father-of-the-bride just lost their jobs and the wedding plans are going up in smoke. David Tutera will need all his skill and savvy to create the perfect Tuscan wedding in southern California.

programme.title: Dragonfly Bride
programme.desc: Bride Regina lost a child and wants a dragonfly-themed wedding as a symbol of hope. David Tutera has his work cut out for him, having to convince the bride that she deserves every part of the gorgeous garden wedding he's creating. The wedding dress Regina bought on sale is already frayed, and the bridesmaid's dresses are all different shades of green -- David's least favorite color for fashion. What's more, Regina and her fiancé are planning a backyard wedding with no food for the guests! David has one surprise after another for this sweet-natured bride, culminating in an emotional fairy-tale wedding with larger-than-life entertainment.

programme.desc: Bride Benita is an actress that wants a Hollywood glam wedding, but she's procrastinated on all the details. Her decorations are better suited to a child's birthday party, and the bridesmaids' dresses remind wedding planner David Tutera of a tube sock! programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In the quarter finals, Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (48-4, 37 KO) takes on kickboxing legend Errol Zimmerman (112-20-1, 45 KO), Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (17-5, 10 KO) meets number one French heavyweight Sofian Laidouni (42-5-1, 20 KO), monstrous Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (29-4-1, 16 KO) clashes with ‘The Soldier’ Nidal Bchiri (20-5-1, 5 KO), and ‘The Black Ghost’ Mory Kromah (35-3-1, 21 KO) collides with outspoken rival Michael ‘Timebomb’ Boapeah (23-5-1, 29 KO). programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Dale searches for priceless motorcycles to bring to the Vegas auction.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: The Senior Vice President at Home Depot, Gordon Erickson at is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concourse have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, non Harley or Indian machines.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: The Son of Zorro
programme.desc: In imperial Mexico, Don Ricardo Villaverde leads a double life as the masked Son of Zorro, defending the oppressed from the cruel Governor Leblanche. programme.title: Tequila

programme.title: Scalps
programme.desc: The commander of a Texan fort in the Civil War refuses to surrender to the Northerners, and tries to buy the local Indian tribe chief's daughter. programme.title: Cooking Up Love
programme.desc: On a lark, Zoey rents a food truck and enters a reality TV competition. Zoey’s determined to win fair and square and she suspects Mr-Too-Good-To-Be-True is really after her sauce recipe, not her heart.

programme.title: Meet Me in New York

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Leading Lady

programme.title: The Gold Rush
programme.desc: A prospector heads to the Klondike during the wild 1890s gold rush, dreaming of striking it rich, and falls head over heels for a girl he spots at a dance hall.

programme.title: For the Love of Chocolate
programme.desc: As Aria gets ready for the yearly Masters of Chocolate Festival, things take a turn when her partner quits just before the big event. But soon, a charming single dad comes to her rescue, helping her discover the secret to winning.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman

programme.title: An Elephant's Journey
programme.desc: An Elephant’s Journey' is a fun-filled and moving family adventure about a circus elephant and the importance of family and friendship. Starring Disney Channel favourite Jenna Ortega and Hollywood’s David Arquette and Tom Arnold, fans of 'Dumbo' will love this film. Flora is a circus elephant who can no longer perform her tricks. Left out and alone, the circus owner's 14-year old daughter, Dawn, sneaks Flora from the circus after she finds the perfect place for retirement: an elephant sanctuary 480 km away. All that stands between them and the safety of the elephant preserve is hundreds of kilometres of woods, one raging river, two elephant hunters and the fear of not making it.

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: While shooting pool in a Louisiana bar, Andre Daigle meets a beautiful and mysterious woman. That night he disappears. With no clues to go on, Andre's family calls in psychic Rosemarie Kerr - whose remarkable visions provide answers to a baffling crime. In New Jersey, a teenage girl vanishes while walking home from school. Witnesses saw her walking near a young man whose alibi is shaky. But police have no evidence and must release the suspect - who then vanishes himself. Psychic Nancy Orlen Weber joins the case and offers uncannily accurate descriptions of the crime, the suspect - and where he's hiding.

programme.title: InJustice
programme.desc: A child serial killer terrorizes the city of Saskatoon; a high school student is tortured to death over the course of a weekend by a gang. The killer, a man who was pronounced clinically dead in an ambulance and later revived, embarked on a string of serial murders six months later.

programme.title: American Addict
programme.desc: Riveting look at the politics, big business and the medical industry that has made America the most prescription-addicted society in the world. America is less than 5% of the World's population but consumes 80% of the World's prescription narcotics. We have gone from being the land of the free to the land of the addicted.

programme.title: Million Dollar Murders
programme.desc: Million Dollar Murders will highlight the tireless effort of police. When there are few leads left, Police turn to the public for help, offering a one million dollar reward.

programme.desc: Examining real cases and critical events where truth, consequence, and human decisions collide.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: Summer, 2001 and Southern Louisiana is held in the terrifying grip of a serial killer whose initial ‘hot zone’ is the Louisiana State University area of Baton Rouge. The number of victims is growing and all are attractive, successful young women -- women whose mainstream, “low risk” lifestyle should never put them on the radar of a killer. But this is the hardest kind of serial killer to catch -- impulsive, always changing his M.O. An unprecedented coalition of state and federal police agencies, including the FBI, will join forces to solve this disturbing, yet fascinating case. State of the art forensic science, particularly case-making DNA analysis, will turn the tables on this killer and finally put a face to the monster that haunts Southern Louisiana.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: Summer, 2001 and Southern Louisiana is held in the terrifying grip of a serial killer whose initial ‘hot zone’ is the Louisiana State University area of Baton Rouge. The number of victims is growing and all are attractive, successful young women -- women whose mainstream, “low risk” lifestyle should never put them on the radar of a killer. But this is the hardest kind of serial killer to catch -- impulsive, always changing his M.O. An unprecedented coalition of state and federal police agencies, including the FBI, will join forces to solve this disturbing, yet fascinating case. State of the art forensic science, particularly case-making DNA analysis, will turn the tables on this killer and finally put a face to the monster that haunts Southern Louisiana.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: On the outskirts of Hamilton, Ontario, a jogger makes a gruesome discovery – the partially mummified remains of a human body. Using state of the art forensics, police are able to identify the body as that of a suburban wife and mother of two. She has been brutally bludgeoned to death, but no missing person’s report has ever been filed. As police investigate, they discover evidence of domestic strife, including a love triangle and charges of assault. Determined to find the killer, police dig further into the victim’s life, doggedly tracking down a former lover to New York City, where they uncover another crime. But it is a forensic entomologist and her knowledge of the minute lives of insects that leads investigators back to Ontario and the arrest of the woman’s husband for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Factor

Armed with the very latest in forensic technology, this is one game the cops have no intention of losing.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: A series of over sixty spectacular fires rips through California’s San Joaquin valley, killing four people and devastating the landscape. An extensive investigation by the ATF, police and forensic scientists reveals a common pattern among all the blazes, and to their horror, authorities soon realize that a serial arsonist is on the loose. As they painstakingly study the evidence from each crime scene, a single fingerprint leads them to one suspect. He is John Leonard Orr, a respected arson investigator for the Glendale Fire Department in Southern California and one of the worst serial arsonists of the 20th century.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: A double homicide in Hudson, Wisconsin leaves a small town reeling and two young detectives with little to go on. The victims are upright citizens, shot execution style, with no apparent motive. In Agatha Christie-like fashion, a tantalizing array of suspects emerge but after two years, there are still no arrests. Richard Walter, the famed criminal profiler, becomes intrigued by the cold case and narrows the suspect list down until only one man is left standing. And no one can believe who that person is. A combination of expert crime scene analysis, computer forensics and the perpetrator’s own pathological urge to talk… the bereaved families finally see justice served.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: Glamorous Las Vegas, Nevada is famous for wealth, lady luck and second chances. But when homicide detectives discover the charred remains of a prominent business man, Sin City reveals a darker side. With a long list of suspects and millions of dollars on the line, investigators are suddenly thrust into a dangerous world of high stakes deception fueled by passion, greed and revenge. A murder mystery where nothing is as it seems and anyone is capable of anything, only forensic science can expose the truth and catch the killer.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritius is a multi-ethnic, multilingual and multicultural society. After chatting to his guide, Denis, about his Indian heritage Brent is curious to get to know more about the unique Hindu culture of Mauritius. Travelling deep into the heart of the island he heads to Ganga Talao, a sacred crater lake situated in a secluded mountain area where a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva brings in hundreds of pilgrims every day. There he meets with Priest Dayal who takes him on a tour of Hindu culture and beliefs, opening Brent's eyes to a fascinating part of this multifaceted island. Being ever the adrenalin junky, Brent isn't willing to let the rain put a dampener on his planned quad biking safari. Speeding through the pouring rain, Brent heads to the top of a mountain in the Domaine De L'Etoile Réserve, in hopes of catching a glimpse of the fabled view. He then returns to his apartment and is warmed up by some tasty fusion Indian cooking using the Mauritian staple, Okra.

programme.title: 7 Miles of Paradise
programme.desc: The North Shore is a 7 Mile stretch of paradise like no other on Earth. Every year thousands of people flock to the North Shore of Oahu to see the world's best surfers ride arguably the world's best waves. Pro surfers have created their careers, made their livings and even become legends from surfing these shores. Pro surfer Anastasia Ashley will be your tour guide and take you to the places she loves, the places she went as a kid growing up there, and introduce you to the people that always made it feel like home. We will experience and understand why she loves the North Shore, and considers it '7 Miles of Paradise'

programme.title: The Essence of Surfing
programme.desc: The Essence of Surfing is a riveting surf documentary that gets to the heart of why surfing is the greatest sport in the world. Featuring surfers of all kinds, from the neighborhood grom to some of the greatest surfers to ever live, The Essence of Surfing uncovers what it is about this awesome sport that makes it a necessary part of each of their lives. Shot in the world's most beautiful locations by top notch Cinematographers Erik Ippel and Mike Prickett, this film is sure to hook and inspire anyone looking to get wet and catch some waves.

programme.title: Loading & Transporting On Site The Huge Liebherr 984 Excavator
programme.desc: In today’s incredible ground footage, we follow the full behind-the-scenes process of preparing, loading, and transporting one of the largest excavators in the mine — the mighty Liebherr 984 hydraulic excavator.

programme.title: Liebherr 974 Excavator & Cat 352F With Hydr. Hammer Loading Stone Layers In Bell B50D
programme.desc: The Liebherr 974 hydraulic excavator, a true beast of the quarry world, is loading Bell B50D articulated dump trucks with material that has first been broken up by the Caterpillar 352F excavator, equipped with a Montabert hydraulic breaker. The breaker works relentlessly to fracture tough rock formations, allowing the 974 to load fast and efficiently.

programme.title: Cat 385C, Terex RH30F & Liebherr 954 Excavators Breaking & Loading Stones
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we are deep inside a massive mining operation, watching a powerful lineup of three heavy-duty excavators working in perfect coordination to break and load extremely hard stone layers. - Leading the operation is the Caterpillar 385C excavator, equipped with a heavy bucket, responsible for loading broken debris onto Caterpillar dumpers. Supporting this are the: - Terex RH30F fitted with a vibro ripper, used to tear through tough rock layers - Liebherr 954 outfitted with a hydraulic breaker, smashing dense stone into manageable pieces - This combo of ripping, hammering, and loading shows how professional operators and the right equipment can handle even the hardest terrain.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: Through just 5 years on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Patrick Walters has an incredible resume. He added another accolade with a win at Lake Murray, doing so in impressive fashion. Congratulations to ‪@patrickwaltersfishing5121‬, he is the Marathon Peak Performance at the 5th stop of the 2024 season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Austin Felix
programme.desc: Austin Felix had an impeccable smallmouth record in Bassmaster Elite Series events prior to Lake Oahe, but the Minnesota pro went to another level after four successful days in South Dakota. In the Marathon Peak Performance at Lake Oahe, watch Austin Felix take home his first tour-level victory with Bassmaster.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Will Davis Jr.
programme.desc: In his Marathon Peak Performance of the week, watch Will Davis Jr. win his first Bassmaster Elite Series title in dramatic fashion on his home body of water. Davis won by just 2 ounces over Brandon Palaniuk, making it the closest margin of victory since Toledo Bend of 2011.

programme.title: Peak Performance - John Crews
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Johns River went to ‪@JohnCrews‬ as he led wire to wire to win his second career Bassmaster Elite Series event. Watch his week from behind the lens as he strived for another major tournament victory as a professional fisherman.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie Classic
programme.desc: A story a decade in the making unfolded at the 2022 Bassmaster Classic when ‪@Christiefishing‬ notched his first Classic victory at Lake Hartwell. Watch Christie's Marathon Peak Performance from start to finish as he climbed the mountain in the sport of bass fishing and achieved the biggest win in the sport.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Justin Hammer
programme.desc: ‪@justinhamnerfishing‬ followed his passion and that dream led him to the Bassmaster Elite Series. After a few years on the Elites, he was in the catbird seat of the 2024 Bassmaster Classic where his lifelong dream came true and he became the World Champion of bass fishing. Watch his week unfold at Grand Lake O' the Cherokees in Oklahoma.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Buddy Gross
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance at the Harris Chain of Lakes went to Buddy Gross who came from behind to win his second career Bassmaster Elite Series event. Watch Gross go to work and win big in Florida.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie
programme.desc: Jason Christie led three days of the Elite Series event at the Sabine River and rode a great two days of fishing to the winners circle in his return year to the Bassmaster Elites. He is the Marathon Peak Performance at the Sabine.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, watch as Patrick Walters wins his 2nd Elite Series victory and breaks the 100-pound mark for the 3rd time in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance - LukePalmer
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Luke Palmer has been dubbed as one of the most consistent pros early in his career. His first four years all found him in the 20’s for Angler of the Year and while he’s shown signs of his ability, wins have eluded him. At Santee Cooper he has his Marathon Peak Performance as he follows up a 4th last year, with a win in South Carolina in 2023.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Takumi Ito
programme.desc: Taku Ito got another blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series with his big win at Smith Lake. Relive his week in Alabama where he conquered spotted bass en route to his second Elite Series win since joining the top ranks in 2020.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Bryant Schmitt
programme.desc: Bryan Schmitt is one of the winningest anglers in professional fishing and his great track record is noted on grassy river fisheries. Schmitt ended 2022 with a big victory on the Mighty Mississippi River in La Crosse, Wisconsin. Watch his stellar week in the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament.

programme.title: Peak Performance - CliffPrince
programme.desc: Watch Cliff Prince's winning week at Wheeler Lake in this edition of the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament. Prince found a magical spot where the fishing was on fire the first two hours of every tournament day and it lasted all four days en route to his first blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series. The area was 4 to 5 feet deep and Prince maintained a low profile and fished his chatterbait around grass and over a hard spot without using his forward facing sonar.

programme.title: 2026 Elite Season
programme.desc: Day 1 coverage of the 2026 FXR Bassmaster Elite Series on Lake Guntersville in Scottsboro, Alabama, featuring cold conditions, tight weights, big late bites, and strong grass‑driven limits on a legendary fishery.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When the flower fairy Nymph arrives at the Smurf Village, all the Smurfs fall for her charm and wit. And soon they learn that she is to be some sort of Mama Smurf to them...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf recalls Dreamy's exciting voyage on the high seas and his gripping adventures with sea turtles, whales, desert islands... and pirates!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel's theft of the Fairies' gold almost brings a state of war between the Fairies and the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs' theatrical production of 'Robin Smurf' comes to life as the legendary hero is portrayed by a really good actor...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A beautiful princess is turned into a hag and needs the whiskers of a cat and the tear of a Smurf for her magic potion. Azrael, Grouchy and Jokey unwittingly cooperate and as the magical transformation takes place, the princess frees them and they happily hurry home.

programme.title: How To Smurf A Rainbow
programme.desc: Mother Nature is too busy to conjure a rainbow for the Smurfs' festival, so Papa Smurf borrows her cookbook and mixes up the recipe himself. As there is no yellow available, they use the leprechaun's gold to produce a beautiful rainbow before Gargamel can steal it.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Brainy and Baby mix up Papa Smurf's formulas, leaving them powerless before an army of hungry locusts unleashed on the forest by Gargamel.

programme.title: Lumbering Smurfs
programme.desc: Greedy tree cutters plan to chop down King Gerard's forest while he is away on vacation. Papa Smurf disguises the Smurfs as ghosts to scare the lumberjacks who willingly surrender to the returning King and his array.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In his search for a grander hovel, Gargamel looks in the Great Book of Spells to conjure up a new home. But all of his spells backfire and that convinces him that there's no place like home!

programme.title: Speak For Yourself, Farmer Smurf
programme.desc: Farmer hides his love for Smurfette by assuming a disguise and sending her poems. When they finally meet, they are captured by Bigmouth and in their struggle to get free, they discover their mutual friendship.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel infects Hefty's heart with hate and then uses the little Smurf as a decoy for the others. Fortunately, Hefty's love overcomes his hate and he helps his little friends escape from Gargamel's clutches.

programme.title: To Smurf A Thief
programme.desc: The Smurfs and Homnibus befriend an unfortunate boy who is forced to steal for his master. Soon, the evil thief is turned over to the magistrate and the boy is happy to live with Homnibus.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Little Sickly turns into a hero when he forgets his ailments and saves the rest of the Smurfs from the deadly forget-me flowers.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs are so busy testing their individual willpower that they fail to notice Gargamel has captured Harmony. Only when Papa Smurf offers Gargamel a trick box to test his willpower does Harmony escape.

programme.title: Clumsy Luck
programme.desc: The Smurfs learn about superstition when Clumsy breaks Vanity's mirror prior to a meteor shower. When a meteor falls on Clumsy's house, everyone attributes it to bad luck, but realize the foolishness of this philosophy when they see Clumsy was not in the house at the time.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: Vanity's Closest Friend
programme.desc: To Vanity Smurf there is no spectacle more enlightening, no pursuit more rewarding than looking at himself. When he meets an admiring imp, he's sure he's found his best friend ever. But things are not always that simple, and friends can make trouble.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Everyday the same routine, the same chores, the same life. Smurfette is bored with it all. Wouldn't a long sailing trip on the high seas be a lot more fun? It just so happens that Dreamy Smurf is planning a cruise. Won't that be paradise?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clockwork becomes too hot handle when he's hit by lightning. Papa has to hurry to cool him off before he burns himself out. But Clockwork nearly uses his last volt of power saving the Smurfs from Gargamel.

programme.title: Smoogle Sings The Blues
programme.desc: Chlorhydris plots to change spring into the unhappiest time of year. She goes after the Bluebird of Happiness, and transforms him into a cawing raven. Whoever hears the Song of the Raven of Unhappiness will be unhappy. It's up to Grouchy to save spring.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil Maestro's magical paints have the power to transport his models onto canvas – forever! Papa Smurf directs Painter to switch his paints and before long, Maestro is enshrined in a picture next to his dream girl, Smurfette.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha disguises herself as the Golden Smurf Award to catch the Smurfs in order to use them as the main ingredient in her beauty cream. Vanity convinces her to try his recipe and before long, the wicked sorceress is covered with mud and sent careening over the hills into Gargamel's house.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf organizes a crew to sail to Smurfberry Island because Gargamel has killed all of the trees except one to trap the Smurfs. Gargamel follows them, but once more fails to catch them because the Witch of Smurfberry Island sends her nose-eating seagulls after them.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs learn that the mind is more powerful than matter when they are fooled by a quack's outrageously expensive miracle tonic. But Papa Smurf cures the Smurfs of their temporary naiveté and the charlatan of his villainy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: While out on a mischief-making mission to destroy the Smurfs' Happy Halloween party, Gargamel and Hogatha catch Lazy who has been accidentally turned red by Mother Nature. Papa and the Smurfs help Lazy escape while Mother Nature has Father Time help turn Lazy's red into blue just in time for the Halloween party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Stuff Dreams Are Smurfed Of
programme.desc: Gargamel has devised a new plan whereby he can annihilate the Smurfs: he is now going to influence their dreams! Luckily, Papa Smurf has heard about the magical Gold Crown of Dreams...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Poor Lazy Smurf cannot sleep any more. He believes he is living his last moments and sets out to do all the exciting things he was always too sleepy to do before...

programme.title: The Kaplowey Scroll
programme.desc: There is a terrifying magic word. When you direct the word at something or someone, you make it vanish into nothingness! Can the Smurfs undo its evil power before Gargamel gets hold of it?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What is in this curious box that the Smurfs found on the riverbank? If they knew, the Smurfs would not dream of opening it. And they would avoid Gargamel's clutches.

programme.title: Sleepwalking Smurfs
programme.desc: This time, Gargamel feels sure he has found the final solution to the vexing Smurf question. His magic flute is going to turn their peaceful slumber into a nightmare...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Each morning, dew is deposited by water sprites on forest leaves. Wait till you see what happens when Scaredy Smurf gets hold of the dew-making magic wand...

programme.title: Foul Weather Smurf
programme.desc: Handy invents a weather machine that will allow the Smurfs to control their environment at will. Unfortunately, they cannot agree on whether it should rain or be sunny so the machine overloads and explodes.

programme.title: Spelunking Smurfs
programme.desc: The starving Smurfs discover a cave that has a stash of frozen food inside guarded by an equally frozen troll who was imprisoned because of his greed by a magic diamond. As the Smurfs defrost the cave, Gargamel steals the food, but the magic diamond transforms him into an icy mass and the freed troll happily helps the Smurfs carry the food back to their village.

programme.title: The Smurfs And The Money Tree
programme.desc: The wicked wizard Gargamel has come up with yet another diabolical plan with the help of his mother, who isn't much nicer than him. He wants to tempt the Smurfs with money of which they have no notion. Will Greedy take the bait?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: The Magic Stick
programme.desc: With a borrowed recipe from Homnibus, Papa Smurf creates a magic stick that Clumsy takes and loses in the woods. Soon after, Bigmouth comes for a visit and before he eats all the smurfberries, Papa Smurf finds the magic stick and whisks the giant away.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As the Smurfs prepare for the Festival of the Stars, Gargamel plants a creature in their midst that smells so rotten that he can easily be traced to the Smurf village. Papa Smurf realizes that Born Rotten is from another planet, and he instructs Feathers to return him to his home before Gargamel finds them.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In another Smurf theatrical super-production based – very loosely – on Alexandre Dumas' characters, a masterpiece of the stage is created, with a few lines from Romeo and Juliet thrown in.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs come to the rescue of two children and their grandfather when a mysterious stranger appears and causes their sleigh to crash. Knocking on Gargamel's door for help puts them and the Smurfs in danger…

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy has built a very complex Smurf machine that does everything. It proves dangerous when it nearly destroys the village, but comes in useful when, with the help of the other Smurfs, it saves the young prince Gerard's kingdom from the queen aunt Imperia's dastardly intentions.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs discover a fountain of youth that is guarded by a wicked troll, who steals Papa Smurf's magic book. They convince Gargamel to help them and the greedy villain runs to get the water, but manages to fall in with the troll. As the two chase each other all over the countryside, the Smurfs are able to retrieve Papa Smurf's book.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Once in a blue moon, as the legend goes, a baby Smurf is delivered to the Smurfs and everyone in the village becomes attached to the new arrival. But a mistake has been made and the stork returns to take the baby back. Grouchy and Smurfette have become so attached to the baby that the baby is returned.

programme.title: Smurfing In Sign Language
programme.desc: The Smurfs meet a woodland elf, who teaches them sign language after Gargamel inflicts a no-speaking potion on them.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Littlest Witch
programme.desc: On an errand to Witch Haven for Papa Smurf, the little blue creatures meet a tiny witch and teach her how to be good while at the same time cause another witch to lose her wicked powers for one year after she falls into the river.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In the distant valley of Nodrog, the Smurfs meet the Molians who try to dissuade them from obtaining the magical Smurf-stone that Papa Smurf needs to cure his gout.

programme.title: Smurfy Acres
programme.desc: The Smurfs learn there's no place like home when Gargamel gets the Book of Spells to conjure up a new and more beautiful place for the Smurfs to live; a place that is very convenient for him to lay a trap for them!

programme.title: Wedding Bells For Gargamel
programme.desc: The Smurfs befriend a maiden in distress who is betrothed to Gargamel by convincing her father that the foolish wizard is insane.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs help a fairy queen outwit the evil fairy Fallon who tries to take away her son's magic rattle.

programme.title: All Creatures Great And Smurf
programme.desc: Nat Smurf is convinced he can help all creatures with his healing ways, even the wicked Azrael after he gets his paw caught in a trap. He heals well, but even though he is tempted to stay with the Smurfs, he runs back to Gargamel while leading his old master away from Smurf Village.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel wants to create a monster. A horrible, gigantic creature, an awesome being that is going to destroy all the Smurfs! But Gargamel makes a slight mistake, and the result is going to astonish him and his cat Azrael.

programme.title: The Gargoyle Of Quarrel Castle
programme.desc: In Quarrel Castle, you almost never hear a kind word. Both Selwyn the Warlock and Tallulah, his witch-mate, spend their time quarrelling. Tharp, their pet gargoyle, takes refuge in the Village of Smurfs. But something terrible is going to happen....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Accidents do happen. This time it is Jokey Smurf's mistake that ends up with his shadow coming to independent life! And the shadow loves to play practical jokes on the whole population of the Village of the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy's latest invention, the Smurfomatic Picture Maker, looks like just the thing to replace Painter's snail's-pace art. But Handy's aerial snaps of Smurf Village fall into Gargamel's hands. The Smurfs' only hope is to lead him astray.

programme.title: It's A Smurfy Live
programme.desc: All the Smurfs yell at Handy when his inventions break down, so he leaves the Village. But when Gargamel uses Handy's abandoned machines to trap Smurfs, Handy realises he can't abandon his friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy becomes King of the Trokels by mistake. When Brainy starts giving orders instead of doing what the Trokels want, they decide to overthrow him, which means throwing him over cliff. Brainy learns it takes more than giving orders to make a leader.

programme.title: Pappy's Puppy
programme.desc: A bump on the head wipes out Puppy's memory. Gargamel finds him and decides to train him to hunt Smurfs. Together they capture the Smurflings. Then Gargamel hits Puppy on the head, and he remembers who his real friends are.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy learns it’s better to have smurfed than not to have smurfed at all when he learns his true love is really a mermaid. Can they really live with each other forever?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As the Smurfs busily build a time capsule for all of their talents, Papa Smurf frantically tries to unravel an ancient Druid riddle before disaster strikes the forest.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wonderful joy of Christmas for Baby Smurf and everyone else is almost ruined by the evil Chlorhydris who puts a spell on Mr. Nicholas to stop him from spreading holiday cheer. Fortunately, Papa Smurf and his little blue creatures break the spell and Christmas spreads over the land once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wicked wizard Gargamel asks the sorcerer Balthazar for a recipe to capture the Smurfs. It involves kidnapping Mother Nature to stop the arrival of Spring. Luckily, the Smurfs save the day.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs discover the spirit and joy of friendly competition when they hold their first "Smurfic Games". After a near miss with the troublesome cat Azrael, the Smurfs decide they need to get into better shape. Papa Smurf suggests that the Smurfs tone their bodies as well as sharpen their athletic abilities by inaugurating the "Smurfic Games".

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clumsy Smurf's misadventures take him across a river into Pussywillow Hollow. There he meets the Pixies – charming and shapely beings whose enemies, the Wartmongers, will meet the Smurfs in some unforeseen ways.

programme.title: The Stuff Dreams Are Smurfed Of
programme.desc: Gargamel has devised a new plan whereby he can annihilate the Smurfs: he is now going to influence their dreams! Luckily, Papa Smurf has heard about the magical Gold Crown of Dreams...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Poor Lazy Smurf cannot sleep any more. He believes he is living his last moments and sets out to do all the exciting things he was always too sleepy to do before...

programme.title: The Kaplowey Scroll
programme.desc: There is a terrifying magic word. When you direct the word at something or someone, you make it vanish into nothingness! Can the Smurfs undo its evil power before Gargamel gets hold of it?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What is in this curious box that the Smurfs found on the riverbank? If they knew, the Smurfs would not dream of opening it. And they would avoid Gargamel's clutches.

programme.title: Sleepwalking Smurfs
programme.desc: This time, Gargamel feels sure he has found the final solution to the vexing Smurf question. His magic flute is going to turn their peaceful slumber into a nightmare...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Each morning, dew is deposited by water sprites on forest leaves. Wait till you see what happens when Scaredy Smurf gets hold of the dew-making magic wand...

programme.title: Foul Weather Smurf
programme.desc: Handy invents a weather machine that will allow the Smurfs to control their environment at will. Unfortunately, they cannot agree on whether it should rain or be sunny so the machine overloads and explodes.

programme.title: Spelunking Smurfs
programme.desc: The starving Smurfs discover a cave that has a stash of frozen food inside guarded by an equally frozen troll who was imprisoned because of his greed by a magic diamond. As the Smurfs defrost the cave, Gargamel steals the food, but the magic diamond transforms him into an icy mass and the freed troll happily helps the Smurfs carry the food back to their village.

programme.title: The Smurfs And The Money Tree
programme.desc: The wicked wizard Gargamel has come up with yet another diabolical plan with the help of his mother, who isn't much nicer than him. He wants to tempt the Smurfs with money of which they have no notion. Will Greedy take the bait?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: The Magic Stick
programme.desc: With a borrowed recipe from Homnibus, Papa Smurf creates a magic stick that Clumsy takes and loses in the woods. Soon after, Bigmouth comes for a visit and before he eats all the smurfberries, Papa Smurf finds the magic stick and whisks the giant away.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As the Smurfs prepare for the Festival of the Stars, Gargamel plants a creature in their midst that smells so rotten that he can easily be traced to the Smurf village. Papa Smurf realizes that Born Rotten is from another planet, and he instructs Feathers to return him to his home before Gargamel finds them.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In another Smurf theatrical super-production based – very loosely – on Alexandre Dumas' characters, a masterpiece of the stage is created, with a few lines from Romeo and Juliet thrown in.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs come to the rescue of two children and their grandfather when a mysterious stranger appears and causes their sleigh to crash. Knocking on Gargamel's door for help puts them and the Smurfs in danger…

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy has built a very complex Smurf machine that does everything. It proves dangerous when it nearly destroys the village, but comes in useful when, with the help of the other Smurfs, it saves the young prince Gerard's kingdom from the queen aunt Imperia's dastardly intentions.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs discover a fountain of youth that is guarded by a wicked troll, who steals Papa Smurf's magic book. They convince Gargamel to help them and the greedy villain runs to get the water, but manages to fall in with the troll. As the two chase each other all over the countryside, the Smurfs are able to retrieve Papa Smurf's book.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Once in a blue moon, as the legend goes, a baby Smurf is delivered to the Smurfs and everyone in the village becomes attached to the new arrival. But a mistake has been made and the stork returns to take the baby back. Grouchy and Smurfette have become so attached to the baby that the baby is returned.

programme.title: Smurfing In Sign Language
programme.desc: The Smurfs meet a woodland elf, who teaches them sign language after Gargamel inflicts a no-speaking potion on them.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Littlest Witch
programme.desc: On an errand to Witch Haven for Papa Smurf, the little blue creatures meet a tiny witch and teach her how to be good while at the same time cause another witch to lose her wicked powers for one year after she falls into the river.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In the distant valley of Nodrog, the Smurfs meet the Molians who try to dissuade them from obtaining the magical Smurf-stone that Papa Smurf needs to cure his gout.

programme.title: Smurfy Acres
programme.desc: The Smurfs learn there's no place like home when Gargamel gets the Book of Spells to conjure up a new and more beautiful place for the Smurfs to live; a place that is very convenient for him to lay a trap for them!

programme.title: Wedding Bells For Gargamel
programme.desc: The Smurfs befriend a maiden in distress who is betrothed to Gargamel by convincing her father that the foolish wizard is insane.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs help a fairy queen outwit the evil fairy Fallon who tries to take away her son's magic rattle.

programme.title: All Creatures Great And Smurf
programme.desc: Nat Smurf is convinced he can help all creatures with his healing ways, even the wicked Azrael after he gets his paw caught in a trap. He heals well, but even though he is tempted to stay with the Smurfs, he runs back to Gargamel while leading his old master away from Smurf Village.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel wants to create a monster. A horrible, gigantic creature, an awesome being that is going to destroy all the Smurfs! But Gargamel makes a slight mistake, and the result is going to astonish him and his cat Azrael.

programme.title: The Gargoyle Of Quarrel Castle
programme.desc: In Quarrel Castle, you almost never hear a kind word. Both Selwyn the Warlock and Tallulah, his witch-mate, spend their time quarrelling. Tharp, their pet gargoyle, takes refuge in the Village of Smurfs. But something terrible is going to happen....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Accidents do happen. This time it is Jokey Smurf's mistake that ends up with his shadow coming to independent life! And the shadow loves to play practical jokes on the whole population of the Village of the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy's latest invention, the Smurfomatic Picture Maker, looks like just the thing to replace Painter's snail's-pace art. But Handy's aerial snaps of Smurf Village fall into Gargamel's hands. The Smurfs' only hope is to lead him astray.

programme.title: It's A Smurfy Live
programme.desc: All the Smurfs yell at Handy when his inventions break down, so he leaves the Village. But when Gargamel uses Handy's abandoned machines to trap Smurfs, Handy realises he can't abandon his friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy becomes King of the Trokels by mistake. When Brainy starts giving orders instead of doing what the Trokels want, they decide to overthrow him, which means throwing him over cliff. Brainy learns it takes more than giving orders to make a leader.

programme.title: Pappy's Puppy
programme.desc: A bump on the head wipes out Puppy's memory. Gargamel finds him and decides to train him to hunt Smurfs. Together they capture the Smurflings. Then Gargamel hits Puppy on the head, and he remembers who his real friends are.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy learns it’s better to have smurfed than not to have smurfed at all when he learns his true love is really a mermaid. Can they really live with each other forever?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As the Smurfs busily build a time capsule for all of their talents, Papa Smurf frantically tries to unravel an ancient Druid riddle before disaster strikes the forest.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wonderful joy of Christmas for Baby Smurf and everyone else is almost ruined by the evil Chlorhydris who puts a spell on Mr. Nicholas to stop him from spreading holiday cheer. Fortunately, Papa Smurf and his little blue creatures break the spell and Christmas spreads over the land once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wicked wizard Gargamel asks the sorcerer Balthazar for a recipe to capture the Smurfs. It involves kidnapping Mother Nature to stop the arrival of Spring. Luckily, the Smurfs save the day.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs discover the spirit and joy of friendly competition when they hold their first "Smurfic Games". After a near miss with the troublesome cat Azrael, the Smurfs decide they need to get into better shape. Papa Smurf suggests that the Smurfs tone their bodies as well as sharpen their athletic abilities by inaugurating the "Smurfic Games".

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clumsy Smurf's misadventures take him across a river into Pussywillow Hollow. There he meets the Pixies – charming and shapely beings whose enemies, the Wartmongers, will meet the Smurfs in some unforeseen ways.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Determined to fly over Smurf village to catch a Smurf to take to the Wizard's Convention, Gargamel invokes his Book of Spells to help him. A series of funny flying machine mishaps occur and Gargamel is once more the laughing stock of the Wizard's Convention.

programme.title: The First Telesmurf
programme.desc: Papa Smurf pours a magic potion over the new Smurf-melon patch, which instantly grows and grows all over the village and forest. The Smurfs use the blossoms as a telephone, but before Gargamel can trace their voices, the flowers turn into melons and telesmurf is no more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In his search for something new, Vanity dons a Gargamel-made magic hat that transforms his face into a mess. Through trickery, Papa Smurf gets the antidote from the wicked wizard and once more, Vanity is beautiful.

programme.title: No Time For Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy, Brainy, Clumsy, and Smurfette discover the hourglass of time in a cave and due to their bungling, time spins erratically out of control for all of the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Due to a wild experiment Clumsy is able to store endless knowledge into his memory. Gargamel captures him, trying to unlock Papa Smurf's invisibility formula, but at the last minute, Clumsy tricks him with the wrong ingredients.

programme.title: Good Neighbour Smurf
programme.desc: When Brainy's house burns down, he moves in with his fellow Smurfs; and one by one they kick him out because of his meddling.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf gives Weakling a special cream to wear that will restore his strength. Shortly after, he is awarded for his daring deeds of strength and his confidence really soars when he realizes the cream is smurfberry jam.

programme.title: Harmony Steals The Show
programme.desc: Harmony unwittingly signs a contract with Ghost Writer for a symphony that imprisons him in a ghostly nightclub for life! Papa Smurf demands a jury trial with ghostly jurors and a judge that finds Harmony innocent and Ghost Writer guilty of plagiarism.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha the witch promises Gargamel a magical whistle if he will introduce her to the warlock of her dreams. But they are both deceived by each other's trickery: Gargamel dresses up as the warlock, and Hogatha's magical whistle is only a birdcall.

programme.title: A Bell For Azrael
programme.desc: Gargamel puts a spell on a bell attached to Azrael's tail that will lead the cat to the Smurfs. Papa Smurf outwits him with a counter-spell that leads the wizard to Big Mouth instead of the tasty Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hefty dresses like Smurfette to lure an enamored gnome, Piltkin, away from the Smurf Village. They burrow underground and meet a female gnome who falls in love with Piltkin who then casts Smurfette aside for his new heartthrob.

programme.title: The Magic Earrings
programme.desc: Hogatha manages to obtain the magic golden earrings of Sonoria that will enable her to hear Smurfy voices from afar. Following Lazy's snores, she almost reaches the Smurf Village until Harmony's horn-blasts blow in her earrings and she flies home in a rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil Maestro's magical paints have the power to transport his models onto canvas – forever! Papa Smurf directs Painter to switch his paints and before long, Maestro is enshrined in a picture next to his dream girl, Smurfette.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha disguises herself as the Golden Smurf Award to catch the Smurfs in order to use them as the main ingredient in her beauty cream. Vanity convinces her to try his recipe and before long, the wicked sorceress is covered with mud and sent careening over the hills into Gargamel's house.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf organizes a crew to sail to Smurfberry Island because Gargamel has killed all of the trees except one to trap the Smurfs. Gargamel follows them, but once more fails to catch them because the Witch of Smurfberry Island sends her nose-eating seagulls after them.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs learn that the mind is more powerful than matter when they are fooled by a quack's outrageously expensive miracle tonic. But Papa Smurf cures the Smurfs of their temporary naiveté and the charlatan of his villainy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: While out on a mischief-making mission to destroy the Smurfs' Happy Halloween party, Gargamel and Hogatha catch Lazy who has been accidentally turned red by Mother Nature. Papa and the Smurfs help Lazy escape while Mother Nature has Father Time help turn Lazy's red into blue just in time for the Halloween party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Grouchy, the Smurf who hates everything, doubly hates his own birthday party and goes to hide in Shadow Swamp... He is going to meet strange beings and stranger adventures while the other Smurfs search for him...

programme.title: Smurfiplication
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel creates a magic formula that duplicates everything it touches. And surprise! Suddenly there are six Brainy Smurf! This creates a few interesting situations in the Village... And also at Gargamel's!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A dragon terrorizes the Village of the Smurfs. To put the dragon to rest, the Smurfs must find the noted Chinese traveler. Fortunately, Papa Smurf is able to understand the strange customs of the stranger, and even to speak a few words.

programme.title: The Man In The Moon
programme.desc: Sick and tired of not being appreciated, the Man in the Moon quits his job and retires on Earth, to the Village of the Smurfs. The absence of a First Quarter Moon wreaks havoc in the customs of the Smurfs, and Mother Nature and Father Time get dragged in...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: There is a prize for the cutest pet of a Smurf. Baby Smurf brings a cute, lovely, affectionate Glowing Darling, a pet anybody falls in love with… But this pet is a creation of Gargamel, the evil wizard intent on destroying the Smurfs!

programme.title: Symbols Of Wisdom
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf desperately wants to be more like Papa Smurf. Can a hair tonic be the answer? Can Gargamel be able to finally capture the Smurfs? Does wisdom really reside in a beard?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy feels up to the occasion when he starts the recipe for cookies. He is sure to win the contest: he borrowed a recipe from Papa Smurf's Book of Magic. But a big surprise, and some nasty happenings, await poor Brainy... and the whole Village.

programme.title: Secret Of The Village Well
programme.desc: Why is Clumsy Smurf waiting day and night near the Village well? What is the wish that he wants to be kept secret? How is Gargamel going to be mixed up in this mysterious affair? Is Gargamel going to catch the Smurfs at last?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs must find a bunny family to pull their float in the Autumn Carnival. Gargamel sees his chance to capture the little blue people and disguises himself as a giant bunny. Is he going to catch all the Smurfs in one fell swoop?

programme.title: Stop And Smurf The Roses
programme.desc: Wicked Chlorhydris, the sorceress, wants to destroy all love and beauty on Earth. She has to annihilate Wood Elf Grove, where the loving mute elf Laconia cares for the wild flowers. But the Smurfs are there to save the day.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Jealous of the attention Vanity Smurf receives when he breaks his toe, Jokey Smurf feigns sickness in hopes of getting recognition. Unfortunately, his ploy turns against him and instead of loving care all he receives is the proverbial pound of curse.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The nasty Stalker, who traps wild animals and sells them, has Grandpa and Wild in his clutches. Nanny and Smoogle come to the rescue, catching the Stalker in one of his own traps.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Reporter writes that Gargamel wants to be friends with the Smurfs, after hearing something out of context. Gargamel talks Reporter into taking him to Smurf Village to make his announcement in person. When Gargamel kidnaps the Smurfs, it's up to Reporter to write them out of a tight corner.

programme.title: Bungling Babysitters
programme.desc: While Handy, Brainy, and Greedy argue, Hogatha kidnaps Baby for her Formula for baby-soft skin. It's up to the quarrelling trio, plus Smoogle, to rescue Baby from Hogatha's clutches.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel throws Scruple out, so he moves in with Bigmouth. When the Smurflings help Bigmouth throw a party, Scruple captures them to get into Gargamel's good graces again. But he doesn't count on Bigmouth coming to the rescue.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel has thrown in his slime pond so much poisonous muck that the water becomes enchanted and Gargamel, after falling in, suddenly finds himself much smaller that he would wish. Actually he is going to be so small that Papa Smurf will save him!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: It must be a coincidence: just as an elephant crosses the forest and meets baby Smurf, the Smurfs decide to create a big Smurf Circus. They are going to meet the infernal sorcerer Balthazar and Baby Smurf will have a lot of fun...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel once again meets Esmeralda, the gypsy fortune-teller, and she finds a novel way of getting the gold coin that Gargamel imprudently shows her. But the Smurfs in their turn are tricked into believing there is such a thing as a good-luck tree...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Sliding down a rainbow, a little winged horse loses a golden shoe. He meets the Smurfette and she helps him look for his lost horseshoe. They fall in love somehow, for who could be unmoved by the charm of a little orange horse... Or of a Smurfette?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: There is an evil power in the Titan's crown that Miner Smurf finds underground. And Greedy Smurf is the Smurf to fall victim to it. Then Gargamel comes up with some new schemes to destroy the Smurfs, and everything gets hopelessly tangled.

As he fades away, Marik appears to an unconscious Odion, thanks him for taking care of him and apologizes, wishing that he could take back his cruel actions. Finally, he summons Dark Magician and Dark Magician Girl and uses them to activate Ragnarok – a spell card with the ability to destroy all the monsters on Marik's field, including The Winged Dragon of Ra that he fused himself with. (The card actually negates and removes all cards Marik controls, at the cost of banishing all monsters to the graveyard that Yami Yugi has.) But Yami Marik claims that if Ra is destroyed (which will leave the good Marik with only 1 life point), then the good Marik will be too weak to resist the power of the Shadow Realm, and will consequently lose his soul. Then, Odion arrives (although he is still weak), and tells Yami Marik that he has come to release his master (the good Marik), although Yami Marik counters this by saying that Marik's good half is almost completely gone, and that he is here to stay.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

As Marik continues his onslaught (which begins to injure Odion), Odion tells Marik's good side that together, they had conquered his evil half before, and that they could do it again. Then, he tells the good Marik that since Yami Marik was created by the good Marik's hatred, he has the power to destroy him. As Yami Marik raises the Rod to deliver the final blow, the good Marik disappears from the field, and begins fighting against Yami Marik, who struggles for control over Marik's body, and refuses to be defeated. However, Marik's good half stalls Yami Marik long enough for Yugi to activate his spell card. Yugi's Ragnarok spell succeeds in destroying (and removing to the graveyard) Ra, allowing the good Marik to regain control of his body. However, a sliver of Yami Marik reappears on the field, although this time, he is the victim. Yami Marik tries to convince the good Marik to help him seize the Millennium Items and rule the world together, but fails as Marik has decided to stop being evil and make up for his actions. Marik surrenders the duel to Yugi, which sends Yami Marik to the Shadow Realm, ending the Battle City finals. Bakura and Mai are returned from the shadow realm and Marik is reunited with his siblings, who forgive him. Yugi receives the three Egyptian God Cards. programme.desc: The Securities examine Yusei's body for confirmation of his Mark of the Dragon. Meanwhile, Jack has learned of the legend of the Crimson Dragon and forces himself to obey Goodwin and hosts a Turbo Duel between him and Hunter Pace, who wants a rematch with him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Mr. Armstrong harasses Yusei's friends in front of him and Yusei duels Armstrong with his freedom and the safety of his friends on the line. Armstrong has seized all of Yusei's Decks so Yusei duels him using cards given to him from his friends at the Facility.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The battle to save Yuya's duel school goes galactic when Yuya faces off against Leo Institute's Dipper, an out-of-this-world duelist whose interstellar skills could have Yuya seeing stars!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: It's a gem of a duel when Zuzu faces a fierce Fusion Summoner whose jewel monsters are a cut above the rest! Can Zuzu and her Divas belt out a victory, or will the Leo Institute's diamond of a duelist force a final face-off?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: It's all up to Gong to save You Show from falling into the hands of the Leo Institute! Can Gong stare down defeat without moving his feet, or will a sword-swinging Syncro Summoner slice and dice his way to victory?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: It's a battle under the big top, but no one's clowning around! Yuya duels Declan to determine the fate of Yuya's duel school!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: A suspicious shadow is trailing Yuma. It seems someone has been after Yuma, and their identity is the unassuming girl Cat-chan from Yuma's class. Yuma and Kotori fall into Cat-chan's trap. To rescue Kotori, he's going to have to Duel. Astral is cautious of the strange vibes he's getting from Cat-chan, especially with the strategy of her "Transforming Cat Deck"!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma is reminded that his victories in his current Duels are due to Astral's help. To prove his skills, he fights Shark once more. Though Shark doesn't care to Duel again, he finally agrees when he finally reaches the end of his rope due to Yuma's constant following him around. The Duel of these two begins. Can Yuma win against Shark, who has no "Number" cards, when he himself declares he won't use his "Number" cards or take the aid of Astral!?After his Duel with Shark, Yuma Duels Tetsuo Takeda without "Numbers" and loses twenty times in a row, with Tetsuo angry because Yuma lied about not using the "Numbers" against Shark. Yuma is scolded by Astral on his immaturity. On the other hand, Shark returns to "his place" where he gets involved in criminal company. Yuma, who knew what was going on with Shark, challenges the two strongest thugs: Rikuo and Kaio, to what Shark proposes to be a 2 on 2 "Tag-Team Duel".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After his Duel with Shark, Yuma Duels Tetsuo Takeda without "Numbers" and loses twenty times in a row, with Tetsuo angry because Yuma lied about not using the "Numbers" against Shark. Yuma is scolded by Astral on his immaturity. On the other hand, Shark returns to "his place" where he gets involved with a criminal network. Yuma, who knew what was going on with Shark, challenges the two strongest thugs: Rikuo and Kaio, to what Shark proposes to be a 2 on 2 "Tag-Team Duel".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma finds himself pinned down by the overwhelming power of "Number 61: Volcasaurus". To protect their precious remaining Life Points, he defends Shark at his own expense. When their opponents summon their second Number monster at that point, Astral becomes aware of the hidden mysteries underlying the Duel. In a last-ditch effort, Shark notices Yuma's passion and entrusts him with 1 card that could turn the whole Duel around!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei continues his Duel with Mr. Armstrong, using cards given to him by inmates at the Facility. Despite Armstrong's brutal attack, Yusei refuses to abandon his friends and lose his freedom.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: In order to get back his Deck and Duel Runner, Yusei meets a man named Blister, but he is soon pursued by Trudge, who still wants to get his revenge on Yusei.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei, who got back his Duel Runner and his Deck, continued his Turbo Duel with Trudge. Blister, who is witnessing the Turbo Duel, does not understand why Yusei is so determined to retrieve his "Bonds of Friendship".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo is left unconscious after his harsh Duel with Trudge. The twins Leo and Luna rescue him. After Yusei regains consciousness, Leo demands a Duel with him. Meanwhile, Trudge waits outside in the hopes of capturing Yusei.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei Fudo decides to enter the Fortune Cup, after Lazar blackmailed him to do so, if he wants to see his friends at Satellite alive. On his way, he meets up with his old friends from the Facility, Bolt Tanner and Yanagi and his new friend, Leo at the Daimon Area. Leo and his friend Dexter went to the Daimon Area in order to challenge the mysterious Black Rose.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The Fortune Cup has now begun. The first Duel is Luna vs. Greiger. But since Luna doesn't want to participate, Leo disguises himself and Duels in her place.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Luna and Dexter try to cheer up Leo after his loss to Greiger. They approach Yusei, who tells him the experience he got from losing should prove useful later on. Leo encourages Yusei to win, just before Akiza passes them. She glares intensely at Yusei as she passes. The other three quickly step out of her way. Leo wonders what her problem is.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy.
